description: This file defines the UploadedFileInterface in the PSR-7 HTTP Message standard. It specifies the contract for representing uploaded files, including methods for retrieving stream representations, moving files, and accessing file metadata such as size, error status, filename, and media type.

classes.name: UploadedFileInterface
classes.description: An interface defining the structure for representing uploaded files in HTTP requests, emphasizing immutability and standard methods for file handling.

methods.name: getStream
methods.description: Returns a StreamInterface instance that represents the uploaded file as a stream.

methods.name: moveTo
methods.description: Moves the uploaded file to a new location specified by a target path.

methods.name: getSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the uploaded file in bytes, or null if unknown.

methods.name: getError
methods.description: Returns the error code associated with the file upload, based on PHP's UPLOAD_ERR constants.

methods.name: getClientFilename
methods.description: Returns the filename sent by the client, or null if none was provided.

methods.name: getClientMediaType
methods.description: Returns the media type sent by the client, or null if none was provided.
